title: Break a figure down
question: {measure} · {by} · {period}

means.metres: Approved m², for whoever each dispatch counts for — the figure every month card reads.
means.raised: Quotations requested in the window, each revision its own. A quotation two people share counts once for each of them, and once in the total.
means.issued: Of the quotations requested in the window, the ones that reached a customer. A quotation two people share counts once for each of them, and once in the total.
means.accepted: Of the quotations requested in the window, the ones the customer accepted. A quotation two people share counts once for each of them, and once in the total.
means.approved: Dispatches approved in the window. A dispatch two people share counts once for each of them, and once in the total.
means.reports: Reports written in the window, by the person who wrote them.
means.leads: Leads filed in the window, by the person who passed them, and how many of them are won.

nothing: Nothing to count in this window.
